_glossary.偶拾: The app's name. en/most languages: Oushi; ja, zh-Hant, zh-HK: 偶拾; ko: Oushi.
_glossary.待删除: The deletion queue: photos the user pulled down, kept in the library until confirmed. en: deletion queue / queued for deletion.
_glossary.一组: A batch: the 15–50 photos reviewed in one go. en: batch.
_glossary.翻 / 翻看: Flipping through cards. en: flip through / review.
_glossary.收藏: The Photos app's Favorite. Use each language's Photos app term.
_glossary.恢复: Take a photo back out of the deletion queue. en: Restore.
_glossary.整理记录 / 浏览记录: The app's record of what was seen and queued. en: records / history.

暂时无法载入照片.en: Can’t load this photo right now
暂时无法载入照片.note: On a card whose photo failed to load.

这一项暂时无法修改收藏状态。.en: This item’s favorite status can’t be changed right now.

收藏状态未能保存，请重试。.en: The favorite couldn’t be saved. Please try again.

照片未能删除，请重试。.en: The photos couldn’t be deleted. Please try again.

en.one: %lld item couldn’t be deleted from your library.
en.other: %lld items couldn’t be deleted from your library.

有 %lld 项无法从相册删除。.note: Alert after deleting from the queue: some of the chosen items cannot be deleted by the app (synced from a computer, for example); the rest were deleted.

照片.note: Accessibility name of a photo with no date; also the title line for a photo without a date.

%@的照片.note: Accessibility name; %@ is a formatted date such as 'Oct 10, 2026'.

%@的视频.note: Accessibility name of a video; %@ is a formatted date such as 'Oct 10, 2026'.

视频.note: Title line for a video without a date.

需要访问相册.note: Access card title, before the user has answered.

无法访问照片和视频.note: Access card title, after refusal or when restricted.

这台设备限制了对照片的访问。.en: Photo access is restricted on this device.

请在“设置”中允许偶拾访问照片.en: Allow Oushi to access Photos in Settings
请在“设置”中允许偶拾访问照片.note: Access card text after refusal. No final period.

接下来系统会询问是否允许访问照片。偶拾不会上传你的照片，删除前也都会先经过你确认.en: Next, the system will ask whether to allow access to your photos. Oushi never uploads your photos, and nothing is deleted without your confirmation.
接下来系统会询问是否允许访问照片。偶拾不会上传你的照片，删除前也都会先经过你确认.note: Access card text before the user has answered: says what comes next, so the button can be a plain Continue (App Review 5.1.1(iv): no 'Allow' on a button before the system prompt).

继续.note: Access card button before the system prompt. Must stay neutral (Continue / Next), never 'Allow' (App Review 5.1.1(iv)). Use the system's own word for Continue.

前往设置.note: Button that opens the Settings app.

偶拾.note: App name, shown as the title and on the progress capsule.

再来一组.note: Button / capsule text at the end of a batch.

拍了照片或视频之后再来看看。.en: Come back after you’ve taken some photos or videos.

设置.note: Bar button and the settings screen's title.

关闭.note: Bar button (x icon) that closes the settings screen.

检查媒体.note: Bar button (photo stack icon) and the title of the media-review screen (the deletion queue). Keep short.

恢复.note: Takes selected photos out of the queue.

恢复 %lld 项？.note: Title of the confirmation sheet before restoring; %lld is how many.

恢复后它们会移出待删除，留在相册里。.en: They leave the deletion queue and stay in your library.

已选择 %lld 项.note: Title of the deletion queue screen while photos are selected, in place of its name. Must fit about 220 points at headline size.

第 %lld 个，共 %lld 个.note: Accessibility value of the capsule. Use positional %1$lld / %2$lld in every language.

没有可翻的了.note: Capsule text when the library is exhausted. Must fit about 140 points at 15-point semibold; a short phrase such as “all seen” is fine.

所有内容都看过了.note: Card title once every photo and video has been seen (those in the deletion queue count).

重置浏览进度.note: Progress capsule once everything has been seen; asks before resetting the review history.

重置浏览进度？.note: Title of the alert in the middle of the screen before the review history is reset; its confirm button is 重置进度.

这将清除所有浏览记录。已查看的照片和视频会重新出现，待删除的内容会保留。.en: This clears all review history. Photos and videos you’ve seen will come up again, and the deletion queue is kept.

还剩 %lld 个.note: Capsule text: photos and videos left in the batch. Keep very short.

您已查看 %lld 个内容.note: Title line at the end of a batch. Must fit about 220 points at headline size.

无限.note: Picker option after the batch sizes: a batch of the whole library.

重置进度.note: Settings button and the confirmation dialog's title.

重置进度将会还原所有查看记录，媒体可能重复出现。待删除的内容会保留。.en: Resetting clears every viewing record, so items may come up again. The deletion queue is kept.

左滑或右滑以查看下一张.en: Swipe left or right for the next one

向下拉，放进待删除.en: Pull down to queue for deletion

%@ 查看待删除照片.note: Lesson card 3; %@ is an icon in front of the words. Keep the leading '%@ '.

%@ 更多设置….note: Lesson card 3, last line; %@ is the settings (gear) icon. Keep the leading '%@ ' and the ellipsis.

欢迎使用.note: Shown alone in the middle of the screen for a moment after the last lesson, before the first photo.

开始使用.note: The progress capsule during the welcome; tapping it brings the first photo.

取消收藏.note: Accessibility label of the heart when filled.

没有待删除媒体.note: Pill on the summary card (disabled) and the empty queue screen.

检查 %lld 项媒体.note: Pill on the summary card. Must fit about 280 points at headline size.

这一组翻完了，待删除 %lld 个.note: Accessibility label of the summary card.

左右滑动保留，下滑移入待删除.en: Swipe sideways to keep, down to queue for deletion
左右滑动保留，下滑移入待删除.note: Accessibility hint on a photo card.

关闭声音.note: Accessibility label of the speaker on a video card.

播放.note: Accessibility label of the play button on a video card.

暂停.note: Accessibility label of the pause button on a video card.

之前的整理记录暂时无法读取。.en: Your earlier records can’t be read right now.

整理记录暂时无法保存到本机，这次的记录在退出后会丢失。.en: Records can’t be saved on this device right now. This session’s records will be lost when you quit.

iCloud 同步暂时无法开启，请确认已登录 iCloud。.en: iCloud sync can’t be turned on right now. Make sure you’re signed in to iCloud.

整理记录暂时无法保存，请重试。.en: Records can’t be saved right now. Please try again.

语言.note: Settings row that opens the app's page in the Settings app, where iOS lets the user pick the app's language.

技术支持.note: Settings row that opens the support page.

隐私政策.note: Settings row that opens the privacy policy.

使用条款.note: Settings row that opens the terms of use.

关于.note: Settings row that leads to the About page, and that page's title.

版本.note: Row on the About page; the value is the version number.

开源许可.note: Row on the About page that leads to the open-source license page, and that page's title.

作者.note: Row on the open-source license page; the value is the author's name, Zuming Hu.

源代码.note: Row on the open-source license page that opens the source repository; the address shows under it.

许可证.note: Row on the open-source license page; the value is GNU GPL v3 and the row opens the license text.

附加条款.note: Row on the open-source license page that opens the additional terms added to the GPL under its section 7.

暂时无法载入视频.en: The video could not be loaded right now
暂时无法载入视频.note: On a video card whose video failed to load (from iCloud, or a broken file); a 重试 button follows.

播放位置.note: Accessibility label of the video scrubber's bar; its value is the time played, adjustable by 5 seconds.

原项目.note: Original project attribution on the license page.

名称与图标.note: Separate terms for the original names and icon.

无法连接仓库，以下是 App 内附带的版本。.en: Can’t reach the repository. Showing the copy included with the app.
无法连接仓库，以下是 App 内附带的版本。.note: Shown above a license document when its current text can't be loaded from the public repository (no network, or GitHub unreachable), so the copy bundled with the app is shown instead.

在浏览器中打开.note: Toolbar button on a license document page that opens the file on GitHub; shown as an icon, read aloud by VoiceOver.

代码采用 GNU GPL v3 及附加条款，你可以按这些条款再发布和修改。名称和.en: The code is licensed under GNU GPL v3 with additional terms; you may redistribute and modify it under those terms. Names and the icon are licensed separately. The software is provided without warranty to the extent permitted by law.
代码采用 GNU GPL v3 及附加条款，你可以按这些条款再发布和修改。名称和.note: Footer of the open-source license page: the license, that people may redistribute and modify the code under it, and the warranty disclaimer; the full terms are bundled with the app.

CFBundleDisplayName.note: App name on the Home Screen. ja, zh-Hant, zh-HK: 偶拾. Others: Oushi.

NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription.en: Oushi needs access to your photos to flip through, favorite, and tidy them. Photos you swipe down are kept in a deletion queue first.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription.note: System permission prompt. zh-Hans original: 偶拾需要访问照片，以便随机翻看、收藏和整理你的照片。下滑的照片会先保存在待删除池。
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription.zh-Hans: 偶拾需要访问照片，以便随机翻看、收藏和整理你的照片。下滑的照片会先保存在待删除池。

notLocalized: 所有内容都看过了（有待删除）
所有内容都看过了（无待删除）
